cd /testbed && python -c "
import numpy as np
from astropy.nddata import NDDataRef

array = np.array([[0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 1], [0, 1, 0]])
mask = np.array([[0, 1, 64], [8, 0, 1], [2, 1, 0]])

nref_nomask = NDDataRef(array)
nref_mask = NDDataRef(array, mask=mask)

r1 = nref_nomask.multiply(1., handle_mask=np.bitwise_or)
assert r1.mask is None
r2 = nref_nomask.multiply(nref_nomask, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or)
assert r2.mask is None
r3 = nref_mask.multiply(1., handle_mask=np.bitwise_or)
assert r3.mask is not None and np.array_equal(r3.mask, mask), r3.mask
r4 = nref_mask.multiply(nref_mask, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or)
assert np.array_equal(r4.mask, mask)
r5 = nref_mask.multiply(nref_nomask, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or)
assert np.array_equal(r5.mask, mask)

# copy semantics: mutating result mask must not affect input
r3.mask[0, 0] = 99
assert mask[0, 0] == 0, 'input mask was mutated!'

# reverse order with NDData too
from astropy.nddata import NDData
nd_mask = NDData(array, mask=mask)
nd_nomask = NDData(array)
assert np.array_equal(nd_nomask.multiply(nd_mask, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or).mask, mask)
assert np.array_equal(nd_mask.multiply(nd_nomask, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or).mask, mask)
# other operations
assert np.array_equal(nd_mask.add(1, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or).mask, mask)
assert np.array_equal(nd_mask.subtract(1, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or).mask, mask)
assert np.array_equal(nd_mask.divide(2, handle_mask=np.bitwise_or).mask, mask)
# default handle_mask also works
default = nd_mask.multiply(1.)
assert default.mask is not None and np.array_equal(default.mask, mask)
# collapse (operand=None path) still fine
print('sum mask:', nd_mask.sum().mask)
print('all good')
"
